verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim/Lab supports headless operation, Python scripting/namespace packages, and explicit software-in-the-loop/hardware-in-the-loop validation of robot stacks with ROS 2, which are foundational building blocks for CI-based regression testing, but there is no documented CI pipeline integration (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins) or automated test-runner/regression-suite tooling. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration examples, documented automated regression-test framework, evidence of headless simulation being invoked from a test harness.
